title: Quantization and Graph Operations
summary: This module provides core functionalities for quantizing tensor data into various low-precision formats and managing the computational graph within the GGML backend. It includes tools for model optimization, graph construction (forward and backward passes), and tensor memory management.

nodes.label: Fit Model to Data
nodes.title: Fit Model to Data
nodes.description: Orchestrates the training process for a model, iterating through epochs, managing data batches, and applying optimization steps. It handles data splitting, shuffling, and progress reporting.

nodes.label: Initialize Optimizer Context
nodes.title: Initialize Optimizer Context
nodes.description: Sets up the optimization context, including backend scheduler, compute context, loss type, and graph building parameters, preparing for model training.

nodes.label: Display Training Progress
nodes.title: Display Training Progress
nodes.description: Provides a visual progress bar and statistics (loss, accuracy, time) for each training or validation batch during an epoch.

nodes.label: Quantize Row to IQ3_S
nodes.title: Quantize Row to IQ3_S
nodes.description: Quantizes a row of float data into the IQ3_S format, a specific low-precision integer quantization scheme.

nodes.label: Quantize Row to IQ2_S
nodes.title: Quantize Row to IQ2_S
nodes.description: Quantizes a row of float data into the IQ2_S format, a specific low-precision integer quantization scheme.

nodes.label: Validate Quantized Row Data
nodes.title: Validate Quantized Row Data
nodes.description: Checks the integrity and validity of quantized tensor row data for various GGML types, ensuring no NaNs or infinities are present.

nodes.label: Quantize Row to IQ3_XXS
nodes.title: Quantize Row to IQ3_XXS
nodes.description: Quantizes a row of float data into the IQ3_XXS format, a specific low-precision integer quantization scheme.

nodes.label: Quantize Row to IQ4_XS
nodes.title: Quantize Row to IQ4_XS
nodes.description: Quantizes a row of float data into the IQ4_XS format, a specific low-precision integer quantization scheme.

nodes.label: Quantize Data Chunk
nodes.title: Quantize Data Chunk
nodes.description: Quantizes a chunk of float data into a specified GGML type, handling various quantization schemes and requiring an importance matrix for some types.

nodes.label: Build Backward Graph
nodes.title: Build Backward Graph
nodes.description: Constructs the backward pass computational graph for gradient calculation, identifying trainable parameters and loss tensors, and adding gradient accumulation nodes.

nodes.label: Free Quantization Resources
nodes.title: Free Quantization Resources
nodes.description: Releases resources associated with specific quantization types, cleaning up memory used by quantization implementations.

nodes.label: Copy Computational Graph
nodes.title: Copy Computational Graph
nodes.description: Creates a deep copy of a computational graph, including its nodes, leafs, and hash set entries, preserving the graph structure and tensor references.

nodes.label: Dump Graph to DOT File
nodes.title: Dump Graph to DOT File
nodes.description: Generates a Graphviz DOT file representation of the computational graph, useful for visualization and debugging its structure and tensor properties.

nodes.label: Check Contiguous Allocation
nodes.title: Check Contiguous Allocation
nodes.description: Determines if a given tensor's data is contiguously allocated in memory based on its total bytes and element count.

nodes.label: Calculate Graph Overhead
nodes.title: Calculate Graph Overhead
nodes.description: Computes the memory overhead required for a computational graph, indicating the additional memory needed beyond tensor data.

nodes.label: Calculate Padded Tensor Bytes
nodes.title: Calculate Padded Tensor Bytes
nodes.description: Calculates the total number of bytes a tensor occupies in memory, including padding to ensure proper alignment.

nodes.label: Check 1D Contiguity
nodes.title: Check 1D Contiguity
nodes.description: Checks if a tensor is contiguous along its first dimension, indicating a simple, linear memory layout.

nodes.label: Check 2D Contiguity
nodes.title: Check 2D Contiguity
nodes.description: Checks if a tensor is contiguous along its first two dimensions, indicating a row-major or column-major memory layout.

nodes.label: Get Max Tensor Size
nodes.title: Get Max Tensor Size
nodes.description: Iterates through all tensors in a GGML context to find and return the maximum memory size occupied by any single tensor.

nodes.label: Check Row Contiguity
nodes.title: Check Row Contiguity
nodes.description: Determines if the rows of a tensor are stored contiguously in memory, which is important for efficient row-wise operations.

nodes.label: Check Row Repeatability
nodes.title: Check Row Repeatability
nodes.description: Checks if the rows of two tensors can be repeated or broadcasted compatibly, often used in broadcasting operations.

nodes.label: Reset Graph Gradients
nodes.title: Reset Graph Gradients
nodes.description: Resets the gradients and gradient accumulators within a computational graph, typically at the start of a new optimization step or epoch.

nodes.label: Check Subgraph Fusion
nodes.title: Check Subgraph Fusion
nodes.description: Determines if a sequence of operations within a computational graph can be fused into a single, more efficient operation.

nodes.label: Check Hash Set for Tensor
nodes.title: Check Hash Set for Tensor
nodes.description: Verifies if a specific tensor is present in the graph's internal hash set, used for tracking visited nodes.

nodes.label: Find or Insert Tensor in Hash Set
nodes.title: Find or Insert Tensor in Hash Set
nodes.description: Locates a tensor in the graph's hash set or inserts it if not found, returning its index.

nodes.label: Convert FP16 to FP32
nodes.title: Convert FP16 to FP32
nodes.description: Converts a 16-bit floating-point value (half-precision) to a 32-bit floating-point value (single-precision).

nodes.label: Convert FP32 to FP16
nodes.title: Convert FP32 to FP16
nodes.description: Converts a 32-bit floating-point value (single-precision) to a 16-bit floating-point value (half-precision).

groups.label: Optimization Engine
groups.title: Model Optimization Engine
groups.description: Components responsible for the training loop, model fitting, and reporting progress during optimization.

groups.label: Quantization Core
groups.title: Tensor Quantization Core
groups.description: Functions for converting floating-point tensor data into various low-precision integer formats and validating the quantized output.

groups.label: Graph Management
groups.title: Computational Graph Management
groups.description: Operations for building, copying, resetting, and debugging the computational graph structure, including backward pass generation.

groups.label: Tensor Utilities
groups.title: Tensor Memory and Layout Utilities
groups.description: Utility functions for inspecting tensor memory allocation, contiguity, padding, and size characteristics.

groups.label: Internal Graph Helpers
groups.title: Internal Graph Helper Functions
groups.description: Internal functions supporting graph operations, such as subgraph fusion checks and hash set management for tensors.

groups.label: Data Type Conversion
groups.title: Floating-Point Type Conversion
groups.description: Functions for converting between 16-bit and 32-bit floating-point data types.
